notablePrerequisites:
Rimewind Taskmage does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Rimewind Taskmage.
You control at least four snow permanents.
description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Rimewind Taskmage by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Rimewind Taskmage.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
